static_traits.name: Chen Siyuan
static_traits.social_status: 拥有朋友和家人等支持资源，但not yet与其讨论具体想法与感受；与朋友和家人的关系因对Unmarried的过度关注而紧张
static_traits.medical_history: without重大身体疾病；既往not yet接受心理治疗或心理咨询；此前not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 态度消极且持怀疑态度；表达清晰、逻辑可跟随；能配合探索但对改变缺乏希望；在描述中常use绝对化与“应该”式规则（如“not人会要我”“到这个年龄就该结婚”）

basic_info.main_problem: 一直被“为什么我至今Unmarried”这一类想法困扰，导致Self-doubt与Lowered sense of self-worth；尤其在Seeing happy couples或Attending social activities时加重，且常将Unmarried归因于“have notFemale对我感兴趣”。
basic_info.core_demands: These thoughts are affecting my self-worth and overall well-being; I want to better understand and deal with them.
growth_experiences: 几年前多数朋友陆续结婚，自己感到被落下；自此开始反复思考Unmarried的原因并将其归因为“have notFemale会对我感兴趣”，该信念随时间Reinforcement，逐渐影响自尊、睡眠、饮食及与亲友的关系。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough（因为Unmarried）
have notFemale会对我感兴趣／I am not worthy of being loved

special_situations.event: Most friends are married; oneself feels left behind
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果到这个年龄还not结婚，就说明I am not good enough、have not人会要我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increases socializing and online dating to prove oneself 'can also be chosen'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我失败了／我比他们差／have notFemale人会要我

special_situations.event: 在社交活动中或Seeing happy couples时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 在公众场合Unmarried就会被他人视为not合格、not可取
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distracts attention, avoids discussing these specific thoughts and feelings with family and friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她们一定觉得我not吸引力

special_situations.event: 线上约会或社交尝试后，Female似乎很快失去兴趣
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 几次约会not成功就说明我普遍not具吸引力、without人会选择我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 继续尝试约会与社交以寻找“证明”，但在失败后增强Self-denial
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have notFemale人会要我／这件事utterly hopeless

special_situations.event: 想到自己已48岁仍Unmarried并受社会期待影响
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我这个年龄就应该结婚，not做到就是失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以社会规则衡量自我价值、对Unmarried状态自我施压
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not合格／我have not达到人生的“应有标准”

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be loved and accepted, to build a stable intimate partner relationship and gain social recognition
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、被视为not值得与not可取，从而感到羞耻与自我价值崩溃
defense_goal: 通过分散注意力与避免向亲友透露内心想法来降低Being rejected与羞耻的风险
Keeps a certain distance in the face of intimacy and exposure to maintain fragile self-esteem

object_relations.object_representation: 他人（尤其Female／社会）是评判者与拒绝者
Society and the peer group are comparers with standards and expectations

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor points out that there were also moments in the past of being appreciated or of positive interaction, and encourages acknowledging their value
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为咨询师过度乐观，忽视现实，这些正面时刻“have not用”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以冷淡质疑的语气回应，强调“not意义”“not用”，用事实选择性论证来negate积极证据。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor tries to challenge the inner rule 'should get married' and proposes restructuring it into a more flexible wish
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将改变视为not可能或Meaninglessness，认为自己without法有not同的想法
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use绝对化表述（如“not会改变”“not希望”），语气坚决、简短，避免探讨可行性。

manifestations: Unmarried状态引发“被落下”的体验
在社交场景或看到情侣时感到without人会要自己
Reduces in-depth discussion of inner feelings with relatives and friends
对积极互动的价值感到“not意义”
对改变持怀疑与低希望态度
outcomes: Reduced drive、对咨询与改变缺乏希望
持续的消极情绪与认知固化

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 频繁Self-denial（如“I am not good enough”）
Overly cautious and pessimistic about the possibility of counseling change

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 在社交或约会情境中推断Female“觉得我have not吸引力”
When seeing couples, speculating others' negative views of oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: not与亲友讨论具体想法与感受
Uses distraction as 'pain relief' on self rather than seeking support outwardly

positive_force: Actively tries online dating and increases social contact
Has a certain amount of social support (friends and family)
Willing to seek help and start counseling
negative_force: A 'should' rule rigidly binding self-worth to marital status
与同龄人婚姻状况进行not利比较
Negative cognitive patterns such as jumping to conclusions, mind reading, and overgeneralization
Avoids discussing with family and friends and copes by distracting attention, causing the problem to persist
Long-term negative attitude affects sleep, diet, and attention

target_behavior.behavior: 在社交或约会情境中出现“have notFemale会要我”的消极自动思维并Self-denial，伴随Low mood与回避（分散注意力）
antecedent: The other party loses interest after online dating or social attempts
想到自己48岁仍Unmarried并被社会期待trigger
target_behavior.core_reason: Rigidly binds self-worth to marital status and social expectations, and in comparison situations produces cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and mind reading
target_behavior.function: 逃避Being rejected与羞耻感、维持脆弱的自尊与安全感、通过分散注意力暂时降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、Interpersonal tension、Sleep and diet affected、Reduced work focus，问题持续
